itemText: Add a plan for the statistics page: which learning numbers (reviews and new cards per day, time of day, streak, accuracy) and which spend numbers to show, and where the data comes from.
Record what each AI call was for (card creation, chat, other) and its dollar cost, using an editable price table per model, so spend can be split between cards and chat.
Add an API endpoint that returns learning statistics per day and by hour of day, and AI spend per day split by cards and chat.
Build the statistics page in the web app with simple charts for learning per day, time of day, and AI spend over time for cards and chat.
Show the same statistics on the iPhone.

Build a Statistics page in the web app with tiles (streak, 7-day accuracy, reviews today, spend this month), daily bars, an hour-of-day chart, and cards-versus-chat spend over time, plus an environment badge so dev and prod are never confused.
